stem: If \(5(x - 2) = 3(x + 4) - 2x\), what is the value of \(x\)?
solution: Distribute and simplify the right side: \(5x - 10 = 3x + 12 - 2x = x + 12\).

explanation.A: Incorrect. This is the result of distributing 5 with the wrong sign: \(5x + 10 = x + 12\).
explanation.B: Incorrect. This is the result of distributing 3 to \(x\) only: \(3x + 4\) instead of \(3x + 12\).
explanation.C: Incorrect. This is the value of \(4x\), not \(x\).

verify:
x = symbols('x')
s = solve(Eq(5*(x - 2), 3*(x + 4) - 2*x), x)[0]
assert s == Rational(11, 2)
assert value(choices[answer]) == s
assert all(value(choices[k]) != s for k in choices if k != answer)
